comment: Data that is not written as source: binary images of the original (firmware, tables of the hardware, ...). The source declares each one as an extern variable with its address comment; tools/decomp/extract_data.py copies the bytes from orig/<version>/code.elf into the build directory when code.elf is linked, and fails if an extern declaration has no entry here. Nothing of the original is in the repository.
